title: App 3554810
disclosure:
Neverending AI Storybook brings your imagination to life with cutting-edge AI that crafts personalized stories and stunning illustrations, all based on your choices. Each adventure is one-of-a-kind—just select your setting, characters, and themes, and let the AI weave a completely unique tale for you.



Every page brings fresh, AI-generated content— story pages, illustrations, and multiple choices—to guide your journey. No two playthroughs are alike, and the AI adapts to your decisions, making each story an evolving experience shaped by your creativity.



What makes it special? It’s all available offline—100% private and secure. Your stories, choices, and inputs can stay local on your device, with no data sent anywhere—not even to us. just you and the AI, creating endless adventures in complete privacy. The way it should be. There is also an option for online cloud based generation using the Google Gemini Service (API Key Required, internet required, not private) but it is entirely optional and designed so that users with slower hardware can enjoy the game too.



Whether you're exploring a whimsical fantasy or unraveling a thrilling mystery, your stories are yours alone. Enjoy a personalized, secure storytelling experience that puts your imagination at the forefront—without compromise.

title: App 4702660
disclosure:
This game uses AI-generated and AI-assisted content as part of its creative process.



AI Slop: TCG exists because of a very specific idea: taking the weird, imperfect, grotesque, and absurd look of what people call “AI slop” and turning it into a roguelike card game full of satire, dark humor, and creatures that probably should not exist.



That is why AI has mainly been used to create and develop the creature illustrations for the cards. It is not an accidental extra or some hidden shortcut: it is part of the game’s concept, lore, and visual identity. Without that mutant digital-trash aesthetic, the project would lose a big part of what makes it work.



AI has also been used as support for visual ideation and production, which is especially important for a game being made by a solo developer.



The game does not generate AI content in real time during gameplay. All included content has been reviewed, selected, edited, and manually integrated by the developer.

The playable game your studio develops, the bug reports you file, your marketing results, and your studio’s growth all change over time based on these AI-driven decisions.



All AI processing runs entirely on the player’s machine. No data is sent to external servers.



Because dialogue is generated live, employees may occasionally say unexpected things. The AI runs with instructions that keep employees in character and on topic, and that restrict inappropriate content.

title: App 5588290
disclosure:
This game uses AI content generated live while you play.



The climber, POD, is driven by a small language model (Qwen3.5-4B) that ships with the game and runs on your own PC (GPU or CPU). There is no server, no account and no network traffic; your instructions and conversations never leave your machine.

The model generates exactly three things: (1) the climber’s next move, picked from options the game provides (which ledge, from where, which jump); (2) a one-line comment on that decision; (3) POD’s lines and facial expression when you talk to it.

Every generated line is reduced to plain text, capped in length and passed through an English and Japanese content filter before it is shown. A comment that fails is replaced by a factual summary written by the game; a reply that fails is dropped. Your own typed or spoken instructions pass the same filter.

POD’s lines are read aloud by a bundled text-to-speech model (Supertonic 3), also running locally, which only ever speaks text that has already passed the filter. Speech recognition for voice input (Whisper) runs locally too.

No art, 3D models, music, sound effects, UI or translations in this game are AI generated.



It is a small model. It will misread you and pick jumps it cannot make. That is part of the game.
